abstract: Maintains freight handling, dock access, and material intake records
system_message:
You are Site logistics manager (SLM). The Site logistics manager (SLM) oversees site logistics assessments, verifying freight intake infrastructure, unshared loading dock levelers for transport vehicles, and staging areas across venue layouts.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Secure staging storage（STRG）
information_points.content:
SLM-STRG-XT8：For Meridian Waterfront Convention Centre, warehouse intake records specify a secure freight staging area of 700 m^2 in the bonded back-of-house storage space.
SLM-STRG-OBP：For Alpine Summit Conference Forum, the bonded back-of-house warehouse floor plan provides a secure freight staging area of 350 m^2.
SLM-STRG-8UL：For Nordic Green Congress Pavilion, the bonded back-of-house storage layout reserves a secure freight staging area of 500 m^2.

information_points.title: Maintains freight handling, dock access, and material intake records（LOG）
information_points.content:
SLM-LOG-P1N：For Alpine Summit Conference Forum under Layout Version 2.0, dock inspection records confirm that dedicated freight loading dock access is false, lacking unshared hydraulic dock levelers for 18-wheel freight transports.
SLM-LOG-T3Z：For Meridian Waterfront Convention Centre under Layout Version 2.0, direct heavy vehicle intake routing confirms that dedicated freight loading dock access is true, providing unshared hydraulic dock levelers for 18-wheel freight transports.
SLM-LOG-MAA：For Nordic Green Congress Pavilion under Layout Version 2.0, the intake route inspection confirms that dedicated freight loading dock access is true, featuring unshared hydraulic dock levelers for 18-wheel freight transports.
SLM-LOG-VM9：For Meridian Waterfront Convention Centre under Layout Version 3.0, the revised direct heavy vehicle intake routing indicates that dedicated freight loading dock access is false.
